title.purpose: Section headings within a case study.

body.purpose: All continuous reading prose, capped at a 720px measure.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, nav links, tags, at-a-glance labels, buttons — never continuous prose.

shadows.name: postit-lift
shadows.purpose: The Don't Be a Stranger post-it board — real paper notes, the one place a shadow represents an actual object.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default CTA button — ink fill, pill shape, hover fills signal-red.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: Jost, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; text-decoration: none; color: #FDFCFA; background: #16161A; padding: 8px 24px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid #16161A; transition: background-color .15s ease, color .15s ease, border-color .15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background: #8E1620; border-color: #8E1620; color: #FDFCFA; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary button — transparent fill, hairline border, fills solid ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: Jost, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #16161A; background: transparent; padding: 8px 24px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid #E6E2DB; transition: background-color .15s ease, color .15s ease, border-color .15s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover, .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { background: #16161A; border-color: #16161A; color: #FDFCFA; }

components.name: Tag
components.description: Case-study skill tag — flat pill, muted, never an accent color.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; font-family: Jost, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #33333A; background: #F4F1EC; border: 1px solid #E6E2DB; border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 16px; }

components.name: Fact Grid
components.description: Signature Outcome/Learnings component — one accent cell, rest plain white, thin ink gaps standing in for borders. Never fill every cell.
components.html:
2,700+institutions now use it
Led four developers through the build.
Full design system shipped alongside the redesign.
components.css: .ds-fact-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1fr; gap: 3px; background: #16161A; border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-fact-grid > div { background: #FFFFFF; padding: 24px; } .ds-fact-accent { grid-row: span 2; background: #BE1E2D; color: #FDFCFA; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; } .ds-fact-stat { font-family: Jost, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 26px; line-height: 1.15; } .ds-fact-stat-label { font-size: 15px; opacity: .9; margin-top: 8px; } .ds-fact-cell { font-family: Jost, sans-serif; font-size: 20px; color: #16161A; }

components.name: Ink Grid
components.description: Generalized ledger grid for text/photo cells (case-study 'moments'), sharp corners, no outer radius, same ink-gap mechanism as Fact Grid.
components.html:
• The first time someone picked up during the pilot and we had a real conversation.

  • Reading the post-its for the first time.
components.css: .ds-ink-grid { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 3px; background: #16161A; } .ds-ink-cell { background: #FFFFFF; margin: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 24px; min-height: 120px; } .ds-ink-cell p { font-family: Jost, sans-serif; font-size: 20px; color: #16161A; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: The system reads like a ledger, not a brochure: flat ink-gapped grids, sharp corners, and a restraint borrowed from real Mondrian compositions, which are mostly white space with one or two color accents, never a filled block per cell. That restraint isn't decorative minimalism; it's an extension of the site's actual editorial discipline — every factual claim traces to a primary source, and the visual system is built to look like it's keeping the same kind of honest record. The type pairing carries the same duality: Jost for anything structural, EB Garamond for the actual reading experience of the case-study prose. Structure is Bauhaus; the reading itself is editorial.
keyCharacteristics: Mostly white space, one color accent per composition — never every cell filled.
Flat color fields; no gradients, no glassmorphism, no soft ambient shadows.
Shadows appear only where they represent a real physical object, never as generic elevation.
Sharp corners on the ledger family; a small 6px softening only on photographic/color containers.
Fully round (pill) shapes reserved for interactive affordances only.

rules.name: The Ink-Text Rule
rules.body: Gold never carries text at its bright value — always substitute ochre-gold-ink the moment gold needs to be legible.

rules.name: The One-Accent Rule
rules.body: Every Mondrian-style grid gets exactly one colored accent cell, never a filled-every-cell treatment.

rules.name: The Structural-Sans Rule
rules.body: Jost is never used for reading prose, only for anything the reader scans rather than reads. EB Garamond owns continuous prose exclusively.

rules.name: The Single-Column Rule
rules.body: No case-study section pairs running text with a sticky or side-by-side image column.

rules.name: The Physical-Object Exception
rules.body: A shadow is only added because the thing it's attached to is a real physical object in life — never as a generic elevation affordance.

rules.name: Every State Sets Both
rules.body: Every button state sets background-color and text-color together, never one without the other.

dos: Do keep exactly one colored accent per Mondrian-style grid composition.
Do set background-color and text-color together on every interactive state.
Do use ochre-gold-ink, never bright ochre-gold, whenever gold needs to carry legible text.
Do reserve shadows for things that are physical objects in real life.
Do keep every case-study section single-column.
donts: Don't add drop shadows, blur, or soft ambient elevation to the ledger family.
Don't reintroduce a two-column sticky-media case-study layout.
Don't use Inter for body copy.
Don't add a persistent floating in-page navigation rail.
Don't apply a rounded corner to anything in the ledger family.
